description: This file defines classes and traits related to data flow and graph elements in Spark SQL pipelines, including Flow, FlowFunction, and various specific Flow implementations.

classes.name: QueryContext
classes.description: Contains the catalog and database context information for query execution.

classes.name: Flow
classes.description: A node of data transformation in a dataflow graph, describing data movement into a dataset.

classes.name: ResolvedInput
classes.description: A wrapper for a resolved internal input that includes the user-provided alias.

classes.name: FlowFunction
classes.description: A trait defining the transformation function of a Flow, expressed as a DataFrame.

classes.name: FlowFunctionResult
classes.description: Holds the DataFrame returned by a FlowFunction along with inputs used.

classes.name: UnresolvedFlow
classes.description: A Flow whose output schema and dependencies aren't known.

classes.name: ResolutionCompletedFlow
classes.description: A Flow whose flow function has been invoked, either resolved or failed.

classes.name: ResolutionFailedFlow
classes.description: A Flow whose flow function failed to resolve.

classes.name: ResolvedFlow
classes.description: A Flow with known output schema and dependencies, implements Input.

classes.name: StreamingFlow
classes.description: A ResolvedFlow representing stateful movement of data to a target.

classes.name: CompleteFlow
classes.description: A ResolvedFlow declaring what data should be in the target table.

classes.name: AppendOnceFlow
classes.description: A ResolvedFlow that reads source(s) and appends data once.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Defines the transformations performed by a Flow, returning used inputs and a DataFrame.

methods.name: inputs
methods.description: Returns the set of TableIdentifiers used when resolving the Flow.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Returns errors occurred during analysis of the Flow.

methods.name: resolved
methods.description: Indicates whether the Flow has been successfully analyzed.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the DataFrame for a ResolvedFlow.
